subject.title: [Bug]: voice-call manager crashes on answered conversation calls when realtime config is absent

question: Should maintainers require live answered-call proof before another fix PR, or accept source-level and focused manager-test proof for the optional realtime guard?
rationale: The bug path is real in the manager when `realtime` is absent, but normal runtime config currently fills that object and the previous exact fix PR closed unmerged after the real-proof gap remained.

options.title: Require live answered-call proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted runtime logs, terminal output, recording, or a reproducible provider-environment transcript before queueing another automated fix.

options.title: Accept focused source/test proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the manager-level proof and promote a narrow fix PR that applies optional chaining plus regression coverage.

options.title: Close only if reachability is disproven
options.body: If maintainers confirm missing `realtime` cannot occur through supported shipped paths, close with that source-backed explanation instead of landing a defensive guard.

recommendation.title: Require live answered-call proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted runtime logs, terminal output, recording, or a reproducible provider-environment transcript before queueing another automated fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the current realtime short-circuit and has the strongest recent voice-call manager/config/test history for the proof-sufficiency decision.
